data: How many pruning methods are compared in figure 2?

The figure shows two subfigures. The left subfigure is labeled "Densities versus oracle error rates of lattices generated by different pruning methods," and the right subfigure is labeled "Time spent on generating the lattices with different pruning methods." In the left subfigure, there are three lines representing different pruning methods. Therefore, the number of pruning methods compared in figure 2 is three.
